caseName: Regents of the University of California v. Bakke
caseNameFull: Regents of the University of California v. Bakke

opinions.text: Sup. Ct. Cal. [Certiorari granted, 429 U. S. 1090.] Motion of Members of the Congressional Black Caucus et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae denied. Each party to this cause is directed to file within 30 days a supplemental brief discussing Title VI of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 as it applies to this case.
